name: Missionary Work By Ministers
overview: Scripture reveals that missionary work by ministers is a divinely appointed task, exemplified by God's direct commissioning of Moses to lead Israel out of Egypt, assuring him of His presence and guidance in speech and action. The sending of Levites alongside priests, as recorded in 2 Chronicles, underscores the organized and collaborative nature of this labor. These passages emphasize that God equips and empowers His servants to faithfully carry out His mission, highlighting both the responsibility and the divine enablement involved in ministerial outreach.
